question: Can the frozen Test 6 clocks remain distinct and numerically controlled for six periods in a two-center axisymmetric outgoing-layer quiet evolution?

method.action: Unchanged SS OCF 1 flat fixed-doublet axisymmetric Hamiltonian; outer momentum damping is numerical and its exact energy/charge sinks are integrated with RK4.
method.units: c=hbar=m=1; time and length in m^-1; energy in m.
method.domain: Single center at z=0 and pair at z=±36, h=.2/.1, 24 radial by 32/64 axial half lengths; pair-wide h=.2 radial32 and axial half80.
method.boundaries: Mirror far boundary, cosine-squared momentum sponge of strength .12 in outer 4 units (wide: 6); energy and charge sinks measured, domain control tests spurious return.
method.initial_data: Byte-locked Test 6 omegaQ=.9 profile, omegaChi=.41274991 and clock peak .001; naive pair superposition, no joint solve, a=pia=0. No source or subsequent force.
method.solver: Axisymmetric annular finite-volume RHS, canonical pi_a and reciprocal backreaction, RK4; six frozen signed-field periods; separately vary spatial grid, dt at fixed h and outer domain. Operational preset: strict serial-per-case Numba CPU backend with full neutral sector, no fast math, checkpoint every 5000 steps. Independent cases may be scheduled concurrently under recorded CLI policy; physical preparations, grids, sample strides and thresholds are unchanged.
method.tolerances: Max |E+sink-E0|/initial mode E <.01; |Q+sink-Q0|/Q0<.01; post-2-period projected E within 1%; frequency and jitter within1%; pair separation >3Rc; matched trace controls <5%. These are six-period qualification values; no full acceptance.

hypotheses.prediction: Two cores and their local projected clocks remain distinct and readable over six periods with bounded sink-corrected residuals and independent-control differences.
Clock, charge centers or energy ledgers fail, or time/domain changes explain a supposed quiet baseline.

controls.purpose: separate spatial embedding from pair drift
compare spatial embedding and quiet evolution

controls.method: pair-wide enlarges both boundaries at h=.2

criteria.pass_if: Both remain exact floating point zero

criteria.observable: Direct E and Q plus integrated absorber sinks
criteria.pass_if: Energy residual <1% initial clock mode energy, charge residual <1% initial Q in every case
Separation >3*17.8, drift <2 and local charge fraction ≥.99 in pair cases

criteria.observable: Projected clock energy and local ticks
criteria.pass_if: Post-two-period mode energy within 1%, frequency and jitter within 1%, at least three tick intervals

criteria.observable: A matched mode trace across pair-fine, pair-time, pair-wide
criteria.pass_if: Maximum trace difference <5% initial base amplitude for each
criteria.uncertainty: Two spatial levels do not establish asymptotic contraction

criteria.unresolved_if: Naive pair plus free settling is not a joint stationary solve

criteria.pass_if: Full isolated and quiet baseline and controls pass
Both sources, recoil, survival and handoff pass
